page.cadence() (régularité envoyée au serveur: (){const t=clickTimes.splice(0);if(t.length<30)return undefined;const iv=[];for(let i=1;i<t.length;i++){const d=t[i]-t[i-1];if(d>0&&d<1000)iv.push(d);}if(iv.length<30)return undefined;const m=iv.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/iv.length,cv=Math.sqrt(iv.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-m)**2,0)/iv.length)/m;const per=new Map();for(const x of t){const k=Math.floor(x/1000);per.set(k,(per.get(k)||0)+1);}const ks=[...per.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b),full=ks.slice(1,-1).filter(k=>per.has(k-1)&&per.has(k+1)).map(k=>per.get(k));const pm=full.length?full.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/full.length:0,psd=full.length?Math.sqrt(full.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-pm)**2,0)/full.length):0;return{n:iv.length,cv:Math.round(cv*1000)/1000,secs:full.length,ps:Math.round(pm*10)/10,psd:Math.round(psd*100)/100};}
